# AI in Finance Daily — 2026-08-05

*One AI hedge fund's ashes, a Chinese ETF melt-up, and Citadel calling a half-trillion-dollar debt binge.*

## 🔎 The lead

**The Aschenbrenner implosion is now a full post-mortem — and a market-structure warning.** Situational Awareness lost **67%** on concentrated AI bets and was forced to sell **~$16B of stock to Citadel at a deep discount** [9](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE10ck9tU2VlSjNMei1McnQxNk1SbWYxOHBOTWpiQjcwRS1KQ3hUY0I4ZHNjRXQ3NkVlYVFta2Q0TnA2aGNpM014QThsNnpPNzJ1TXI4aW9LZzk2cGJ4UUtrTGxVb2VNM0loaWFWdVc1am1zUQ?oc=5), a fund that "imploded in just 30 days" [38](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPOGFkOHJ4U3ZzRjRnSlU1Mng2eGlxcTNCUC1fa3hLRkwtNmZWNDJOUXpMVnZQRWR4M3ZjMVljNFFmUWJWLUR3ZFJlZm1ralRxUUJrSkFXb1ZodVVBcHlmNmwyeW5Jck9MNGtkaGFVdzRDdklfNnVCTGZ2NVFsVkNkeTNaVzNyQmRoWTJGUmZsR28wSzhlMnBGME1QNm9KWTRtbV9pV3l2UQ?oc=5). The damage wasn't isolated: Whale Rock sank **22%** as the AI selloff hit [10](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxQdGVXangtWjVMRFhtdklyMVVCNEYzQ3dtLUlkSk44VFotWkNxVlA0a0VGbU05M3dPcEJVcWNSYkVTcVNCSFdRbjlUQ0p2T0JlZjJuWjkzaEVpUG0zZjg3bU0wZEtCRzNUYldwVEJ3eUswX1Axbk44OGpBeXBXMnMzanNmVmYxMHlzMjk1ZEdnV3JaU2FMTHFxY29EeVJxc3BHcDdlakVRZWxBLXgtbDRHRQ?oc=5) and Millennium lost 2.1% in July [62](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBxazFzQkM1V2Q3d3BDOERyN3ktbTIwSThCMkQ5T0drZEZocTdBQTFsa2hWV3RoSERjTldBNldCMGdfc2habW1fQlotaGVmTmRKTlpKMnNORFZ4SVZ1b2pZS2xDT1NnOEFvMWNZZnJ3aTFoc05VelE?oc=5).
